place: a frozen white ice plain under a stormy sky

story.title: Could this frozen gorilla croc survive the South Pole?
story.hybrid_look: A terrifying apex predator featuring the massive muscular frame and scarred knuckles of a silverback gorilla, fused with the armored osteoderm scales, crushing jaws, and razor-sharp teeth of a giant Nile crocodile.

sentences.text: Have you ever imagined what a fictional monster ruling the frozen ice sheets of Antarctica would look like?
sentences.image: vast expanses of jagged blue glaciers under a pitch black sky with swirling snow

sentences.text: Meet the Goricile, an imaginary beast built with the crushing bite of a crocodile and the brutal arm strength of a gorilla.
sentences.image: a freezing frozen wasteland with fierce howling winds whipping through sharp ice cliffs

sentences.text: When bone chilling polar vortexes freeze the continent, its thick reptilian scales and dense ape fur trap vital body heat.
sentences.image: a violent blizzard of heavy snow blinding the entire icy horizon in white chaos

sentences.text: Navigating treacherous hidden crevasses is easy because its powerful knuckle walking grip secures a safe hold on slick ice.
sentences.image: a deep dark abyss plunging down between massive walls of ancient blue glacial ice

sentences.text: To hunt seals beneath thick ocean ice, its modified crocodile lungs hold oxygen for over an hour in freezing depths.
sentences.image: dark churning freezing ocean water crashing violently against towering walls of coastal ice

sentences.text: Even fierce katabatic winds cannot knock it down, as a low center of gravity keeps the heavy brute completely grounded.
sentences.image: a desolate polar plain battered by extreme wind blowing heavy sheets of loose snow

sentences.text: Yet this mighty nightmare instantly falls asleep during sudden solar eclipses, so what clever trick would you use to escape it?
sentences.image: a pale eerie twilight casting long dark shadows across a barren frozen snowfield
